lines.zh: 我用三条鳍腿在海底走。
lines.en: I walk the seafloor on three fin-legs.

lines.zh: 沙一陷，我的支架歪了一下。
lines.en: The sand gives way and my tripod tilts.

lines.zh: 海沟很窄，我贴着石壁挪。
lines.en: The trench is narrow, so I creep along its wall.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我慢慢逆着游。
lines.en: The current pushes back as I swim slowly upstream.

lines.zh: 我抬高身子，让水从鳃过。
lines.en: I lift myself and let the water cross my gills.

lines.zh: 前面太亮了，我往暗处走。
lines.en: It is too bright ahead, so I walk into the dark.

lines.zh: 尾鳍当第三条腿，踩稳了。
lines.en: My tail fin is my third leg, planted firm.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，像在踩高跷。
lines.en: I hop along like something on stilts.

lines.zh: 岩坡太陡，我打滑往下溜。
lines.en: The rocky slope is steep, and I slip down it.
Do not hurry me; three legs are slow.

lines.zh: 我沿着沟底的裂缝巡一圈。
lines.en: I patrol once along the cracks in the trench floor.

lines.zh: 冷水从深谷里涌上来，很咸。
lines.en: Cold, salty water wells up from the deep valley.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，听水里的动静。
lines.en: I stop at every step and listen to the water.

lines.zh: 走到沟口，我才敢松口气。
lines.en: Only at the trench mouth do I relax.

lines.zh: 我撑起三条鳍腿，慢慢挪一步。
lines.en: I prop myself on three fin-legs and shift one step.

lines.zh: 流水太急，我就停下来等它缓。
lines.en: The current runs hard, so I wait for it to ease.

lines.zh: 沟底的沙太软，我挑石头落脚。
lines.en: The sand is too soft. I pick the stones.

lines.zh: 我伏低走，别让上面看见。
lines.en: I keep low so nothing above sees me.

lines.zh: 我面朝水流，一动不动等食。
lines.en: I face the current and wait, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 三条腿扎进泥里，稳得很。
lines.en: Three legs are planted in the mud, rock steady.

lines.zh: 有只小虾撞我嘴上，我吞了。
lines.en: A small shrimp hits my mouth, and I swallow it.

lines.zh: 我把自己站成一株海草。
lines.en: I stand here pretending to be a stalk of seagrass.

lines.zh: 眼太小，我只能看清近处。
lines.en: My eyes are small, so I only see what is near.

lines.zh: 沟底黑，我懒得再挪地方。
lines.en: The trench floor is dark; I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 水压压得我骨头有点酸。
lines.en: The water pressure makes my bones ache a little.
I blink slowly, and that counts as resting.

lines.zh: 上面有影子游过，我不动。
lines.en: A shadow swims overhead, and I stay still.

lines.zh: 嘴一张一合，滤点浮游物。
lines.en: My mouth opens and closes, filtering whatever drifts by.

lines.zh: 沙粒一颗颗落在我背上。
lines.en: Grains of sand settle one by one on my back.

lines.zh: 这姿势站久了，鳍有点麻。
lines.en: Standing like this so long, my fins go numb.
The trench is quiet, nothing but moving water.

lines.zh: 我打了个小嗝，冒出一串泡。
lines.en: I burp a little and a string of bubbles rises.
You dove this deep; are your lungs holding up?

lines.zh: 我从你面罩里看见自己。
lines.en: I see myself reflected in your visor.
You stepped right beside me, so tread lightly.

lines.zh: 你的靴子搅起一层淤泥。
lines.en: Your boots stir up a cloud of silt.
I tilt my head at the lamp in your hand.

lines.zh: 大个子，你是来捞我的吗？
lines.en: Big one, did you come to scoop me up?
Your bubbles keep rising, and they are loud.
I stare at your swim fins without moving.
You carry the smell of the surface.
Do not grab me by hand; my legs are thin.
Ouch! One of my stands snapped.
Do not poke me, I only have five health.
I curl up and burrow into the sand.
The current knocked me off balance.
That one will take me half a day to recover from.
I quiver my fins and play dead.
Sand got into my gills, and it stings.
I back into a rock crevice, do not follow.
A small patch of scales is gone from my back.
Easy there, my bones are hollow.
Is that shrimp? Give me one bite.

lines.zh: 你手里晃的东西我看见了。
lines.en: I can see that thing swaying in your hand.
I am not picky; shredded fish will do.
Scatter it my way, I cannot reach it there.

lines.zh: 香味沉到沟底了，我闻到了。
lines.en: The smell sank to the trench floor, and I caught it.

lines.zh: 你要喂我，就把手放低点。
lines.en: If you want to feed me, lower your hand.
I shuffled three steps for just this mouthful.
Do not tease me; I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 这味道比我滤的水好吃。
lines.en: This tastes better than the water I filter.
My mouth is open, waiting for you to drop it.
You knocked my tripod out of line.

lines.zh: 我贴着你腿滑过去，抱歉。
lines.en: I slid past your leg, sorry about that.
The trench is crowded, so make room.
My fin scraped your armor, and it is hard.
Do not push, I will tip over.

lines.zh: 鳍和鳍缠住，谁也游不开。
lines.en: Fin tangled in fin, neither of us can swim free.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到我的支架。
lines.en: Your knee bumped against my stand.

lines.zh: 我蹭过你身边，不是故意的。
lines.en: I brushed past you, it was not on purpose.
This gap is only wide enough for one fish.
Step back half a pace, my tail is stuck.
She stands upstream of me, fins trembling.
We stand side by side, waiting on the current.

lines.zh: 我挪到她上游，替她挡水。
lines.en: I shift upstream of her to break the current.
In this trench, she is the only one I seek.
Her tripod is a little thinner than mine.
We press close, leg against leg.

lines.zh: 我把最好的位置让给她。
lines.en: I give her the best spot in the current.
She swims over, and my tail goes numb.
Together we stand as two tripods.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，沟里会多几只。
lines.en: By this time next year, the trench will hold more.
I picked up the shrimp you dropped.
This meat sank, so it is mine now.
I lift your thing with my mouth.
Do not drop iron scraps, I cannot bite them.
Whatever I find on the trench floor is mine.
I drag a blade of seagrass home.
This pebble is bright, so I keep it.

lines.zh: 你的鱼钩挂着饵，我拿了。
lines.en: Your hook still had bait, so I took it.
My mouth is stuffed and I can barely swim.
Light things I can carry on my head.

lines.zh: 上面那条鲨鱼的影子拉长了。
lines.en: The shadow of that shark above grows long.
Something is moving, let me look first.
It is a shrimp, and it cannot reach me.
That dark shape is bearing down on me.
A net! I know that opening too well.

lines.zh: 水一沉，我就知道有大家伙。
lines.en: When the water sinks, I know something big is near.
That fish is smaller than me, so I am not afraid.
I will tuck back into the trench first.

lines.zh: 有人在沟口放了个笼子。
lines.en: Someone set a cage at the trench mouth.
The shadow stopped, and it is watching me.
It circles me, counting my legs.
I fix my eyes on that fishing line.

lines.zh: 它张嘴了，我数到三就跑。
lines.en: It opened its mouth; I count to three and run.
I do not blink, waiting for it to move first.

lines.zh: 沟壁在我背后，没退路了。
lines.en: The trench wall is at my back, no way out.
I flatten down and pretend to be a stone.
Its teeth caught the light, and I saw them clearly.

lines.zh: 水流一变，我就知道它扑了。
lines.en: The current shifted, and I knew it lunged.
I hold my gills shut and endure it.
One step closer and I will spring away.
I flick my tail fin at it once.
I jab my stand at its eye.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，但我尽力了。
lines.en: This will not hurt, but I tried my best.

lines.zh: 我咬了个空，牙磕在一起。
lines.en: I snap at nothing and my teeth clack together.
I butt it with my head, like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 它比我大太多，我照样撞。
lines.en: It is far bigger than me, and I charge anyway.
I blow out a string of bubbles as a smokescreen.
I kick off the seabed and shove upward.
I cannot win, but I will still peck it once.
The tip of my fin scrapes across its skin.

lines.zh: 我从沟底的暗处冒出来。
lines.en: I rise out of the dark of the trench floor.

lines.zh: 这海沟深，刚好放得下我。
lines.en: This trench is deep, just the right size for me.

lines.zh: 水压一到位，我就站起来了。
lines.en: Once the pressure settles, I stand up.

lines.zh: 我和同伴一起落在这条沟。
lines.en: My companion and I landed in this trench together.
The sand has not settled, but I stand already.

lines.zh: 第一次见光，是深海的蓝。
lines.en: The first light I saw was deep-sea blue.

lines.zh: 我从裂缝里挤出来，鳍还软。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack, fins still soft.

lines.zh: 这条沟以前没有我，现在有了。
lines.en: This trench had no me before; now it does.
Cold water flows over me, and I wake.

lines.zh: 两只一起出现，够热闹了。
lines.en: Two of us at once, that is plenty of company.

lines.zh: 海底怎么会着火？烫死我。
lines.en: How is the seabed on fire? It burns.

lines.zh: 摔在沟边的岩石上，鳍折了。
lines.en: Dropped on trench rock, one fin bent the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我离了水才叫淹，别晃我。
lines.en: Out of water I drown, so stop shaking me.
A muffled boom, and the trench wall collapsed.
Something pierced the membrane of my fin.

lines.zh: 咒光钻进鳍骨，我又麻又冷。
lines.en: Hex light soaks into my fin bones, numb and cold.

lines.zh: 滤了半天，什么也没吃到。
lines.en: I filtered all day and caught nothing.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我全身发亮。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sea, and my whole body glowed.

lines.zh: 这片黑没有底，我在往下掉。
lines.en: This dark has no bottom, and I keep falling.
